sources.title: ContextPilot
sources.snippet: Stop paying for tokens your model ignores. Every LLM call carries dead weight. ContextPilot compresses it before your model sees it, with a quality gate so nothing important gets dropped.

sources.title: ContextPilot
sources.snippet: ContextPilot is a context optimizer that sits before the inference engine. Long-context workloads often carry similar, overlapping, or redundant context blocks — wasting tokens and triggering unnecessary KV computation.
